entities.name: Skaal Kesh
entities.description: A zombie dragon from Jund raised into undeath by Meren's necromancy.

entities.name: Meren
entities.description: Meren of Clan Nel Toth, a necromancer who sought vengeance on her old master Kael.

entities.name: Kael
entities.description: Meren's old master, fed to Skaal Kesh.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: The shard of Alara where Skaal Kesh and Clan Nel Toth live.

events.summary: Meren returns to Jund wanting vengeance on her old master Kael and tracks down her people's camp.
events.quote: she wanted to kill her old master, Kael

events.summary: Meren overpowers Kael and feeds him to Skaal Kesh.
events.quote: she fed Kael to Skaal Kesh

relations.note: Meren raised the dragon into undeath.
relations.quote: raised into undeath by the necromancy of Meren

relations.note: She fed Kael to Skaal Kesh.
relations.quote: she fed Kael to Skaal Kesh

relations.note: Meren belongs to Clan Nel Toth.
